themes.title: Efficient, sustainable code models
themes.summary: Compressing code transformers to cut memory and CO2 while keeping accuracy.
themes.key_result: Up to 81% lower CO2 emissions while keeping about 98% of clone-detection accuracy.

themes.title: Just-in-time clone refactoring
themes.summary: Helping developers refactor clones as they write code.

statement: How should software engineering tools adapt when AI coding assistants generate and copy code? My work tests whether clone detectors still hold up on AI-generated code, builds benchmarks to measure this, and uses model merging and compression to make code models that generalize across clone domains and cost less to run. The results are released as open benchmarks, tools and replication packages, including GPTCloneBench and MergeSE.
